name: shot-capture
summary: Render a camera view of a scene to a PNG in batch mode, so an agent can look at what it built.
adapt: Let Unity create the .meta files on the next open or compile, then commit them with the script.
Add Shots/ to .gitignore unless you want captures in the repository.

verified.how: Rendered the terrain-from-data scene to PNG in batch mode with the main camera (1600x900) and with a free camera (1280x720); both images were opened and checked. Built-in pipeline only; URP and HDRP not run.
